quizName: Hardest Questions in Vermont Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Why are signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They don't matter much since motorcycles are small.
They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
You only need to use them when other vehicles are nearby.
They work differently than signals on cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: As a motorcycle rider, you are at high risk. Always use turn signals to warn others of your plans. Signal every time you change lanes or turn, even if you think no one is near you.

questions.question: What material are most riding gloves made from?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: What is true about clothing for motorcycle riding?

options.text: It should be loose enough to blow in the wind.
You don't need to cover your arms and legs completely.
You shouldn't wear a jacket when it's warm.
It can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: It can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: Good clothing protects you during a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs fully, even in warm weather. Your clothes should fit snugly so they don't flap but loose enough so you can move freely.

questions.question: Where should you get information about your specific motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Your owner's manual is the best source for information about your motorcycle. It includes details about how to operate it and what maintenance it needs.

questions.question: Which organization certifies helmets for maximum protection?
questions.explanation: Always wear a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards for the best protection.

questions.question: What should you do if a friend has been drinking and wants to ride their motorcycle?

options.text: Tell them to ride on quiet roads.
Get other friends to convince them not to ride.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to convince them not to ride.
questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has been drinking to ride. Do everything you can to stop them. Getting a group of friends to pressure them not to ride can be very effective.

questions.question: Which is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Wear proper protective clothing when riding. This includes sturdy pants and jackets that cover your arms and legs, boots or heavy shoes that support your ankles, and strong gloves.

questions.question: Most motorcycle crashes happen during daylight. What should you do?

options.text: Ride on the shoulder away from traffic.

questions.explanation: Most motorcycle crashes happen during the day. Wear bright clothing every time you ride so other drivers can see you easily.

questions.question: How does riding with a passenger affect a motorcycle?

options.text: It doesn't change how the motorcycle handles.
It's usually safe for new riders.
It changes how the motorcycle handles.
It helps new riders gain experience.

questions.correctAnswerText: It changes how the motorcycle handles.
questions.explanation: A passenger adds weight, which makes a motorcycle handle differently. Only experienced riders should carry passengers.

questions.question: Which does NOT protect a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: To protect yourself, wear a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots that support your ankles, and strong gloves.

questions.question: Even if it is obvious that you are going to turn, you:

options.text: Do not need to use a turn signal.
Should still use a turn signal.
Only need to use a turn signal if there are nearby pedestrians.
Only need to use a turn signal if you are at a stop light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should still use a turn signal.
questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes. Use signals every time, even if you think it is obvious. Other vehicles may be nearby that you cannot see.

questions.question: If you cannot avoid a slippery surface, you should:

options.text: Speed up and lean the motorcycle.
Speed up and keep the motorcycle upright.
Slow down and lean the motorcycle.
Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and keep the motorcycle upright.
questions.explanation: When you hit a slippery surface, slow down and keep your motorcycle upright. Go as slowly as possible across the slippery area.

questions.question: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles:

options.text: Allows you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
Keeps you in a single area of the lane, limiting your movement.
Allows you to rely on others to identify hazards.
Requires you go faster to stay with traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows you time to react if another driver makes a mistake.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle on all sides. This gives you time and space to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: Which of the following should you check before riding?

options.text: The wear and tread of your tires
The amount of cushion your seat has

questions.correctAnswerText: The wear and tread of your tires
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, oil and fluid levels, headlight, tail light, turn signals, brake light, clutch, throttle, mirrors, brakes, and horn.

questions.question: Your body removes alcohol through:
questions.explanation: Only time will remove alcohol from your body. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, you should:

options.text: Keep going and hope to wake up.
Get off the road and rest.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get off the road and rest.
questions.explanation: Do not ride when tired. On long trips, take a rest break at least every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: You should check your mirrors:

options.text: Regularly as part of your normal scanning.
Never, since you cannot do anything about what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regularly as part of your normal scanning.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your regular scanning. Also check them before changing lanes, stopping at an intersection, and before slowing down.

questions.question: Taking corners too fast:

options.text: Can cause you to go into another lane.
Is better than going too slowly.
Usually keeps you in your lane.
Is safe because motorcycles are small.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can cause you to go into another lane.
questions.explanation: Taking a corner too fast can make you cross into another lane or go off the road. Slow down before turning or entering a curve.

questions.question: Which of the following does not need regular checks?
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your tires, controls, chains, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes. Small problems on a motorcycle can be very dangerous.

questions.question: Which of the following is a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Wet pavement, loose gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal covers on the road are slippery. Ride carefully on these surfaces.

questions.question: What helps reduce the risk of head or neck injury in a crash?

options.text: Not allowing a passenger on the motorcycle

questions.explanation: Wearing a helmet is the best way to reduce the risk of head or neck injuries in a crash.

questions.question: Which surface gives a motorcycle the best traction?
questions.explanation: Dry pavement provides the best traction. Wet pavement, gravel, sand, mud, snow, ice, painted lines, and metal plates are all more hazardous for motorcycles.

questions.question: A leather jacket:

options.text: Can make a rider look cool.
Is usually too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket when riding for protection. Leather jackets also help prevent dehydration in warm weather. Many motorcycle jackets are designed to keep you cool.

questions.question: What is the best gear to wear when riding?

options.text: Any gear that helps to protect you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Any gear that helps to protect you.
questions.explanation: Wear gear that protects you while riding. Wear a DOT-approved helmet, eye protection, and protective clothing.

questions.question: ____ can remove alcohol and its effects from your body.
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot reduce alcohol levels or make you sober. They may help you stay awake, but they do not change your blood alcohol level.
